<title level="1" right="Spell 3" pfs="Standard">
[One with Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=1619)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 347

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Soralyon](/Deities.aspx?ID=128), [Yuelral](/Deities.aspx?ID=111)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes or 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

You can either transform into a stone or merge with stone. This spell has the same effects as [_one with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1618), but lets you merge with or turn into stone. A stone you turn into has AC 23. You can Dismiss this spell.
name: One with Stone
